# immutable-context-sim v1.1.0 pin

This directory records the exact imported simulator lineage selected for Simsimmer. It is intentionally **not** a partial runnable vendor copy.

The source ZIP is pinned by SHA-256 in `PIN.json` and `control/external_references.json`. Library evidence records a fresh-extraction 134/134 suite, compileall, clean-venv install, grammar CLI, recursive seed reuse, and cache-hit checks. That historical receipt is provenance; any use in a new execution environment must produce fresh execution receipts.

Do not edit the imported lineage in place. Materialize it by exact hash when needed, or import a complete source tree in a dedicated dependency-update change.
